frozen_configuration.out_of_distribution_rule: prefill_per_request above 64 increases bounded OOD score

execution_order.method: frozen shuffled cyclic Latin-style counterbalance with reversal after a complete cycle

timing_method: host monotonic perf_counter/perf_counter_ns around synchronous CPU execution
outlier_policy: retain every completed semantically valid run
missing_run_policy: a missing or semantically invalid cell invalidates the complete S2.12 measurement set
primary_paired_observation: logical trace x measured repetition block
paired_difference: baseline regret - selector regret; positive favors selector
controlling_interval: trace-cluster bootstrap over one mean paired difference per trace, 10000 samples, seed 2120
tail_method: trace-level empirical p95 difference with cluster bootstrap, 10000 samples
family_acceptance: no family mean selector regret exceeds baseline by more than 0.02
aggregate_acceptance: controlling 95% CI lower bound > 0 and tail upper bound <= 0.005
stopping_rule: execute every preregistered warm-up and measured cell; no interim analysis or early stopping

failure_classifications.full_pass: high-confidence conservative policy profitability and tail non-regression verified
failure_classifications.mean_only: average benefit verified; tail non-regression unvalidated
failure_classifications.failed: selector materially worse than robust baseline
